name: Blade and Black Magic
body:
You have studied spells that complement your agile approach to combat.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, panache class feature, ability to cast 1st-level antipaladin spells.

Benefit(s): Add the following spells to your antipaladin spell list at the indicated levels: 1st-duelist’s parry, 2nd-alacrity, 3rd-dance of a hundred cuts, 4th-greater bladed dash.

The Antipaladin’s Almanac, © 2020, Librarians & Leviathans.
